scope: Corollary 2.2 (Uniform activity bound) of the manuscript “Boundedness and persistence of weakly reversible mass-action systems” (preprints/Boundedness-and-persistence-of-weakly-reversible-mass-action-systems-September-25-2026/paper.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 149 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 f953bd681c2ddb7d), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 9. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: Let m ≥ 1, a < b, and E : [a, b]m → (0, ∞) be as in Lemma 2.1. Fix a finite nonempty family {(rλ, cλ) : λ ∈ Λ} supplied by that Lemma. There is h0 > 0 such that, for every 0 < h < h0 and every p ∈ [a, b]m, each label active at Xh(p) satisfies ∥p − rλ∥∞ < E(rλ). The family is fixed before h0 is chosen.
